```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 ≥ 2 * n + 3 := by
  have h1 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n ≥ 3 := by
    rw [sub_le]
    apply nat.le_sub_right_iff_add_le.mpr
    exact (le_add_right (n ^ 2) 2 n).mpr (le_add_right (n ^ 2) 2 n)
  apply le_trans h1
  exact (le_add_right (n ^ 2) 2 n).mpr (le_add_right (n ^ 2) 2 n)
```
